name: Aoi Cameron
source:
The Communications Officer

An excellent communications officer in charge of the ship’s operations.
She has a demure and quiet personality and is easily swayed.
She and Liz were classmates during their cadet training, and although her background before joining the ship is unknown, she boarded this vessel through Liz’s recommendation.
It seems she is somehow acquainted with Daniel…
